title: Business Bronze Rewards Card: How to Apply and Get Started
summary: Explains how to apply for and get started with the Business Bronze Rewards Card: eligibility requires a minimum personal FICO score of 660 (Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX 20+ helpful). Card benefits include 1.0% cash back, $0 annual fee, 20.49% variable APR, and starting credit line of at least $10,000. Application requires SSN, business details (incl. EIN if available), consent to a personal credit check, and optional PAYDEX input; after approval you activate and set up digital wallet/payments. New customer promo requires $10,000 spend in first 2 months to earn a $500 statement credit (returns/credits reduce qualifying spend).
